flows.name: Authorize an active employee through an active project membership
steps: Resolve the authenticated person as an active internal employee
Resolve an active project directory membership with an access-bearing project or global template
Read the project billing period through the existing RLS policy and API
flows.expectedOutcome: Andrew can see BP-001 on project 1149 through the shared project-access helper

flows.name: Preserve least-privilege boundaries
steps: Deny contacts, inactive people, inactive memberships, other projects, and access-empty templates
Keep company templates company-scoped and project memberships project-scoped
flows.expectedOutcome: Only active internal identities with an existing access-bearing assignment receive project access

flows.name: Verify Andrew's production view
steps: Read back the helper decision in Andrew's authenticated session
Render and capture the Billing Periods tab, then log out the temporary session
flows.expectedOutcome: The API and rendered page both contain the July 2026 BP-001 row

claims.description: An active employee with an active access-bearing project membership can read project-scoped rows protected by current_has_project_access
Legacy users remain supported while contacts, inactive principals, inactive memberships, other projects, and access-empty templates remain denied
The shared helper definition, database grants, and billing-period RLS behavior are covered by repeatable tests
